meta.name: intel-discipline-advisor
meta.description: Triage a competitive or market question into the right intelligence disciplines, cadence, and executing skill. Use when you know something needs researching but not which channel to run.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将市场问题匹配到合适的研究渠道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常遇到市场问题但不确定从哪开始研究
copy.tagline_en: Match market questions to the right research channels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face market questions but don't know where to start researching

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会通过三个自适应问题帮你把竞争或市场问题归类到合适的情报学科、节奏和执行技能，并给出编号建议，同时教你如何将决策映射到学科。
howto.when: 当你有一个需要研究但不确定从哪个渠道入手的竞争或市场问题时触发。

say.text: 我觉得竞争对手A在搞事情，但不知道从哪里查起。
say.note: Claude 会问三个问题，然后推荐学科组合。

say.text: 我这季度只有4小时做竞品情报，怎么分配？
say.note: Claude 会根据时间预算推荐节奏和学科。

say.text: 两个高级工程师刚关注了我们CTO的预印本，招聘页翻倍了，该查什么？
say.note: Claude 会利用已有信号，推荐独立验证渠道。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude triages your competitive or market question into the right intelligence disciplines, cadence, and executing skill through three adaptive questions, then provides numbered recommendations while teaching the decision-to-discipline mapping.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you have a research question but don't know which channel to use.

say_en.text: I think Competitor A is up to something, but I don't know where to look first.
say_en.note: Claude will ask three questions and recommend discipline mix.

say_en.text: I have four hours this quarter for competitive intel — where do they go?
say_en.note: Claude will recommend cadence and disciplines based on time budget.
